question: What evaluation criteria and point values are used to score proposals in the Delaware Office of the State Treasurer's 2021 RFP for deferred compensation plan recordkeeping and administration services?
expected_facts: Total 100 points: (I) Vendor History and Depth of Public Defined Contribution Plan Experience - 10; (II) Scope of Vendor Operations and Ability to Meet Full Range of Requested Services - 20; (III) Plan Sponsor Experience: Website Access & Quality, Administrative and Compliance Support, Relationship Management, Performance Reporting and Industry/Trend Evaluation and Communication - 30; (IV) Participant Communication & Education: Custom Website, Voice Response System and Participant Call Center; Commitment to Customer Service/Issue Resolution; Custom Communication and Education Capabilities, Branding, Onsite Representatives and Guidance/Advice Tools - 30; (V) Overall Cost to Plans and Plan Participants - 10.
acceptance: Five categories with 10/20/30/30/10 points, correctly distinguishing plan-sponsor from participant services. Exhaustive examples within categories are optional.
